claims.claim: Industrial gear box and electric motor 20hp ratio 1:10
claims.evidence: Only a gearbox/speed reducer is visible in the photo; no electric motor appears in frame, so the motor's existence, hp or ratio cannot be confirmed.
Origin/import history cannot be determined from a photo; no shipping marks, import documents or Belgium-specific markings are visible.
No power-on, load test, or running video is shown; a static ground photo cannot confirm function.
Noise/vibration cannot be assessed from a still photo; would need audio/video while running.
No usage logs, hour meter, or wear indicators are visible on the casing.
Bolt/seal condition is not shown clearly enough to confirm the casing was never removed; nameplate and body are blurred.

risks.risk: Electric motor may not exist or may be a separate, unphotographed unit, affecting whether this is a gearbox-only sale or a full gearbox+motor set.
risks.proof: A photo showing the motor coupled to the gearbox, including its own nameplate.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as gearbox only, worst case, no motor included.

risks.risk: Nameplate (ratio, power rating, brand, serial) is blurred, so specs cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: A close-up, in-focus photo of the nameplate.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unidentified generic industrial gearbox, lowest plausible spec tier.

risks.risk: Internal gear/bearing wear or damage not visible externally.
risks.proof: Video of unit running under load, plus photo of oil/grease condition at seals.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-tested/as-is, assuming possible internal wear.

risks.risk: Oil or grease leakage at seals/flange, common in used reducers left on open ground.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all seal and flange joints.

risks.risk: Unit may have been opened/repaired despite claim, affecting originality and warranty value.
risks.proof: Close-up of casing bolts/seals showing no tool marks or tamper evidence.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly opened/reconditioned, not factory-sealed.

risks.risk: Corrosion or sand/moisture ingress from storage directly on bare ground.
risks.proof: Photo of underside/base and shaft area for rust or sand intrusion.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as exposed-storage condition, with possible corrosion risk.

proof_requests: Clear, focused photo of the nameplate showing brand, model, serial, power rating, and ratio.
Photo or video showing the electric motor (if included) attached and its own nameplate.
Video of the unit running under load, audible for knocking or abnormal noise.
Close-up photos of all seals, flanges, and bolts for leaks or tamper marks.
Photo of the underside/base and shaft for rust or sand damage.
response.reason: The witness confirms only an unbranded, unreadable industrial gearbox with no motor visible, so it can be priced at worst case as a bare, unverified-spec unit pending nameplate and motor proof.
